directives.name: CoarScrollbarDirective
directives.description:
Directive that applies custom overlay scrollbars to an element.

Uses OverlayScrollbars library to replace native scrollbars with styleable overlay scrollbars while preserving native scroll behavior.

Example :
<!-- Basic usage -->
<div coarScrollbar>Scrollable content</div>
___COMPODOC_EMPTY_LINE___
<!-- With options -->
<div coarScrollbar [theme]="'light'" [autoHide]="'scroll'">
  Scrollable content
</div>
___COMPODOC_EMPTY_LINE___
<!-- Horizontal only -->
<div coarScrollbar [overflowX]="'scroll'" [overflowY]="'hidden'">
  Horizontal scrollable content
</div>
